description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!
An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code, Codex and other agents as an AI collaborator in your vault.
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
岛仔 Daozai：Rust 构建的 Windows 桌面信息岛。音乐歌词、邮件验证码、日程提醒、待办与 AI 额度，让重要信息轻轻出现在屏幕顶部。
Lightweight (~1.5 MB) open-source screen annotation with click-through mode and keyboard-first shortcuts. For demos, teaching, meetings & screen recording. Windows, macOS.
A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10. Glass fences, live folders, tabs, Peek. Rust, a few MB of RAM at rest, 11 languages, portable.
Foqos allows you to lock apps behind the tap of a NFC tag or scan of a QR code. Free and open source alternative to Brick, Opal, ScreenZen, Unpluq, Scrolly, Blok and more!
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.

Open-source AI Agent for iOS, iPadOS and Android, designed primarily for iPadOS. On-device Linux, 3D/CAD, Notes, Office, Canvas, Python/Node.js, terminal, Git, voice and Skill Hub. BYOK AI; supported local models and native 3D editing on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 工作台，以 iPadOS 体验为核心。
Troupe any Agents in one UI for Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity and 30+ more
Coco Super Intelligence: agent skills, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. One command installs them into the tool you already use.
Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Works out of the Box, settings menu, in-app updates, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.
Note taking and organization; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft OneNote, rebuilt in pure Rust

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.
